# Test vectors

Generated by `go run -tags testtools ./cmd/bundlesign-test`. Every vector below is checked against the real internal/trust and internal/verify code at generation time (see cmd/bundlesign-test/vectors.go, saveChecked); none is committed unless the actual package behavior matches its expected_result / expected_error.

**All keys embedded in these fixtures are freshly generated, test-only ECDSA P-384 keys. They are not used anywhere outside this testdata directory and must never be treated as real credentials.**

| File | Kind | Expected | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `capability_rejection_override.json` | verify | `REJECTED_CAPABILITY` | Override on a kprobe where the host lacks the KprobeOverride capability, rejected by internal/guard's G8 and mapped to REJECTED_CAPABILITY. |
| `case_fold_duplicate_bundle_scope.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SCHEMA` | Bundle payload has both "scope" and "SCOPE", which fold to the same key under Unicode simple case folding. |
| `case_fold_duplicate_envelope_payloadtype.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SCHEMA` | Envelope JSON has both "payloadType" and "PayloadType" at the top level, which fold to the same key. |
| `case_fold_duplicate_root_metadata_keyid.json` | trust_load | `ErrMalformedMetadata` | Root metadata's "keys" map has two entries whose IDs are equal under Unicode simple case folding (an uppercase-hex variant of a real key ID). |
| `duplicate_json_key_nested.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SCHEMA` | Payload JSON has the nested key "targets.selector_digest" twice. |
| `duplicate_json_key_top_level.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SCHEMA` | Payload JSON has the top-level key "scope" twice. |
| `duplicate_policy_names.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SCHEMA` | Two policies in the same bundle share the same name. |
| `duplicate_signature_same_key_threshold2.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SCHEMA` | Two signatures are present but both come from the same key; rejected at envelope parsing (step 1 review A4: duplicate signature keyids are never legitimate and are rejected outright, before threshold counting is ever reached). |
| `ecdsa_signature_attributed_to_mldsa_keyid.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SIGNATURE` | An ECDSA-P384 signature's bytes are claimed under an mldsa-87 key's keyid; evaluated as an ML-DSA-87 signature and rejected as invalid, leaving the distinct-key threshold unmet. |
| `epoch_equal.json` | verify | `REJECTED_EPOCH` | Bundle epoch equals the host's current epoch; epoch must be strictly greater. |
| `epoch_lower.json` | verify | `REJECTED_EPOCH` | Bundle epoch is lower than the host's current epoch (replay of an old bundle). |
| `expired.json` | verify | `REJECTED_EXPIRED` | Bundle's expires is in the past, beyond clock skew tolerance. |
| `expired_root_metadata.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SIGNATURE` | The trust root itself has already expired as of 'now'; no Verifier can be obtained, so the bundle is rejected as if unsigned. |
| `expires_plus_skew_exact_reject.json` | verify | `REJECTED_EXPIRED` | now is exactly expires + 300s (the clock skew boundary); rejected as expired. |
| `expires_plus_skew_minus_one_accept.json` | verify | `ACCEPT` | now is exactly expires + 299s, one second inside the clock skew boundary; still accepted. |
| `guardrail_rejection_unscoped_sigkill.json` | verify | `REJECTED_GUARDRAIL` | A Sigkill action with no matchBinaries at all, rejected by internal/guard's G1 (protected processes: every enforcement selector must have matchBinaries). |
| `host_not_targeted.json` | verify | `REJECTED_TARGET` | Bundle targets a different host UUID. |
| `hybrid_role_only_ecdsa_signature.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SIGNATURE` | Two valid ecdsa-p384 signatures meet the distinct-key threshold, but require_keytypes also needs mldsa-87, which is absent. Must be rejected. |
| `hybrid_role_only_mldsa_signature.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SIGNATURE` | Two valid mldsa-87 signatures meet the distinct-key threshold, but require_keytypes also needs ecdsa-p384, which is absent. Must be rejected. |
| `hybrid_role_satisfied.json` | verify | `ACCEPT` | Targets role requires threshold 2 plus at least one signature each of ecdsa-p384 and mldsa-87; signed by one of each. Must be accepted. |
| `invalid_policy_name.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SCHEMA` | Policy name does not match the required pattern. |
| `key_not_in_targets_role.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SIGNATURE` | Signed by a key that exists in the trust root but only in the log role, not the targets role. |
| `mldsa_keytype_spki_mismatch.json` | trust_load | `ErrKeytypeSPKIMismatch` | Root metadata contains a key declared keytype mldsa-87 whose SPKI is actually ECDSA P-384 DER. |
| `mldsa_signature_attributed_to_ecdsa_keyid.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SIGNATURE` | An ML-DSA-87 signature's bytes are claimed under an ecdsa-p384 key's keyid. Verification dispatches on the KEY's keytype (never anything carried in the signature), so this is evaluated as an ECDSA signature and rejected as invalid, leaving the distinct-key threshold unmet. |
| `mode_audit.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SCHEMA` | Bundle mode is "audit", neither "monitor" nor "enforce" (case-sensitive). |
| `mode_empty.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SCHEMA` | Bundle mode is "", neither "monitor" nor "enforce" (case-sensitive). |
| `mode_enforce_uppercase.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SCHEMA` | Bundle mode is "ENFORCE", neither "monitor" nor "enforce" (case-sensitive). |
| `non_p384_key.json` | trust_load | `ErrKeytypeSPKIMismatch` | Root metadata contains a key whose actual curve is P-256 even though it declares keytype ecdsa-p384. |
| `not_before_minus_skew_exact_accept.json` | verify | `ACCEPT` | now is exactly not_before - 300s (the clock skew boundary); still accepted. |
| `not_before_minus_skew_plus_one_reject.json` | verify | `REJECTED_EXPIRED` | now is 301s before not_before, one second past the clock skew boundary; rejected as not yet valid. |
| `not_yet_valid.json` | verify | `REJECTED_EXPIRED` | Bundle's not_before is in the future, beyond clock skew tolerance. |
| `oversize_envelope.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SCHEMA` | Envelope exceeds the 1 MiB cap because of several large (but individually within-limit) policies; rejected before any parsing. |
| `payloadtype_mismatch.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SCHEMA` | Envelope payloadType does not match the expected bundle media type. |
| `policy_name_mismatch.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SCHEMA` | Policy YAML's metadata.name does not match the bundle's declared policy name (step 2 prompt Part B8). |
| `policy_schema_failure.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SCHEMA` | Policy uses a Kubernetes-only selector (podSelector), rejected by internal/policydoc's B4 allowlist (step 2 prompt Part B). |
| `role_missing_require_keytypes.json` | trust_load | `ErrInvalidRequireKeyTypes` | The targets role's require_keytypes field is omitted entirely; require_keytypes is mandatory on every role (step-04a-review.md R4A-1), so this is malformed metadata, not "no algorithm requirement". |
| `root_role_key_overlap.json` | trust_load | `ErrInvalidRoleDefinition` | A key is listed in both the root role and the targets role; roles must be pairwise disjoint. |
| `root_rollback.json` | trust_update | `ErrVersionRollback` | New root metadata version (1) is not greater than the current version (2). |
| `root_update_ecdsa_to_hybrid_accept.json` | trust_update | `` | Root rotation whose new targets role becomes hybrid (ecdsa-p384 + mldsa-87, require_keytypes both), signed by a threshold of both the old and the new root-role key sets. Must be accepted. |
| `root_update_new_root_missing_require_keytypes.json` | trust_update | `ErrInvalidRequireKeyTypes` | Root rotation to version 2 whose new root's targets role omits require_keytypes entirely, even though it is signed by a threshold of both the old and the new root-role keys. require_keytypes is mandatory on every role (step-04a-review.md R4A-1); the rotation must be rejected and the old (version 1) root kept. |
| `root_update_only_new_hybrid_keys_reject.json` | trust_update | `ErrOldThresholdNotMet` | Same hybrid root rotation as root_update_ecdsa_to_hybrid_accept, but the update envelope is signed only by the new root-role keys, never a threshold of the old ones. Must be rejected. |
| `root_update_signed_only_by_new_keys.json` | trust_update | `ErrOldThresholdNotMet` | Root update to version 2 is signed only by the incoming (version 2) root keys, not by a threshold of the outgoing root keys. |
| `root_update_signed_only_by_old_keys.json` | trust_update | `ErrNewThresholdNotMet` | Root update to version 2 is signed only by the outgoing (version 1) root keys, not by a threshold of the incoming root keys. |
| `root_update_validity_too_long.json` | trust_update | `ErrRootValidityTooLong` | Root update's expiry is 5 years past 'now' at Update time, exceeding the 400-day maximum validity window. |
| `root_version_skip.json` | trust_update | `ErrVersionSkip` | New root metadata version (3) skips ahead of the current version (1) by more than one. |
| `scope_not_allowed.json` | verify | `REJECTED_TARGET` | Host is targeted, but the bundle's scope is not in the host's allowed_scopes. |
| `sixty_five_policies.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SCHEMA` | Bundle has 65 policies, one more than the 64 cap. |
| `tampered_payload_byte.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SIGNATURE` | A validly-signed envelope with one byte of the (decoded) payload flipped after signing. |
| `tetragon_version_too_old.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SCHEMA` | Bundle requires a Tetragon version newer than the host is running. |
| `threshold_not_met.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SIGNATURE` | Targets role threshold is 2; only one valid signature is present. |
| `unknown_json_field.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SCHEMA` | Payload JSON has a top-level field not in the schema. |
| `unknown_keytype_rejected.json` | trust_load | `ErrUnknownKeyType` | Root metadata contains a key entry whose declared keytype ("dilithium3") is neither ecdsa-p384 nor mldsa-87. |
| `valid.json` | verify | `ACCEPT` | A correctly signed, targeted, in-window bundle. Must be accepted. |
| `wrong_key.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SIGNATURE` | Signed by a key that is not present in the trust root at all. |
| `yaml_hash_mismatch.json` | verify | `REJECTED_SCHEMA` | Policy's declared sha256 does not match the actual hash of its YAML. |

PAE length-confusion resistance ("PAE length mismatch") is covered by a dedicated unit test, `TestPAE_LengthPrefixPreventsAmbiguity` in internal/dsse/pae_test.go, rather than a JSON fixture: it is a property of the PAE construction itself, not of any one envelope.
